title: Parthian feudal houses rule Iran for over a thousand years

tellings.quote: >> So, get this. The Parthians rule Iran for 400 years directly.

plain: The Parthians, an ancient dynasty, ruled Iran directly for 400 years, and their noble families kept power there for more than a thousand years in all. A researcher named Jason Jorjani says this, opening with "So, get this." He means it to show how long one ruling bloodline held on behind the scenes.
